title: Diplomatic Tensions Flare as Beijing Warns US Envoy in Hong Kong
description: Beijing's top diplomat in Hong Kong cautioned the new US Consul General, Julie Eadeh, against interfering in the city's internal affairs, highlighting ongoing tensions between China and the US over Hong Kong, trade, and Taiwan. The clash underscores diplomatic sensitivities as Eadeh's actions draw Beijing's ire.

title: Taiwan's Strategic Stand: A Call for European Unity Against Aggression
description: A Taiwanese military officer warns that a Russian victory in Ukraine could embolden China's attack on Taiwan, urging European support for Taiwan's defense. At the Warsaw Security Forum, he highlighted the need for Europe to learn from Taiwan's experience in countering grey zone operations and fostering collective security.

title: Taiwan Officer: Ukraine Loss Would Embolden China Toward Taiwan
description: Taiwanese military official Hsieh Jih-Sheng warned in Europe that a Russian victory in Ukraine could embolden China’s aggression toward Taiwan.

title: Ukraine’s defeat would embolden China to invade Taiwan, says senior intelligence officer
description: A senior Taiwanese intelligence officer has warned that Ukraine's defeat in the war with Russia would embolden China to invade the self-ruling island of Taiwan.
